I am Ryan Marangattu, also known as Ryan Varghese. I work as a Data Analyst at the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center in Cancer Control and Population Sciences.

My work combines REDCap survey setup, Excel data cleaning, literature searches, reporting, and meeting coordination. I am interested in the practical work that makes research data organized, usable, and easier to communicate.

I earned my B.S. in Statistics at California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo, in June 2026. My background includes experimental design, survey methodology, educational research, and statistical computing in Python, R, and SAS.

## This portfolio

This site began as a STAT 365 course project. It now brings together my research background and selected work in statistical computing, visualization, and interactive R Shiny applications. Project dates describe the original work.
